definitions.explanation: A deduction from the usual price.

examples.japanese: {学生|がくせい}{割引|わりびき}はありますか。

examples.english: I bought it at a 20% discount.

examples.japanese: {割引|わりびき}{券|けん}を{使|つか}って{安|やす}く{買|か}えた。
examples.english: I was able to buy it cheaply using a discount coupon.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}は{毎週|まいしゅう}{金曜日|きんようび}にセールをしていて、{全品|ぜんぴん}10%{割引|わりびき}になる。
examples.english: This store has a sale every Friday, and everything is 10% off.

notes:
{割引|わりびき} refers to a reduction in price, commonly used in shopping and business contexts.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- X%{割引|わりびき}: X% off
- X{割|わり}{引|び}き: X0% off (e.g., 2{割引|わりびき} = 20% off)
- {割引|わりびき}する: to give a discount
- {割引|わりびき}になる: to be discounted

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {学生|がくせい}{割引|わりびき}: student discount
- {団体|だんたい}{割引|わりびき}: group discount
- {割引|わりびき}{券|けん}: discount coupon
- {割引|わりびき}{価格|かかく}: discounted price

RELATED WORDS:
- セール: sale
- {値引|ねび}き: price reduction
- {半額|はんがく}: half price
